Subject: POC kickoff & hands-on session — scheduling

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're excited to move forward with a short POC to validate prompt routing and a light load test against our typical spike profile. High level scope:
- Prompt review & tuning for our 30 intent flows
- Routing rules (latency vs cost) in the test environment
- A 30-minute load test to validate autoscaling and KV cache behavior

Can we schedule a POC kickoff + hands-on working session the week of Feb 28? Prefer a 2.5 hour block so we can do prompts, routing, and run the load test. We'd like an agenda and any pre-reads/slides so our engineers can prepare.

Attendees from our side: Elena Morales (Ops), Peter Jenkins (Platform).

Thanks — what times work for your team?

Elena

Elena Morales
Engineering Ops Manager
Acme Corp

Folks — forwarding Elena's request. Thread below. Key actions before we lock the slot:
- Aditya: 10min business intro + 5min success criteria (customer goals: routing accuracy, <100ms 90p latency under nominal, autoscale within 2 minutes on spike)
- Marissa: prepare 6 prompt examples across high/med/low complexity, and a 15-minute live prompt-tuning demo (have prompt sets in the Drive link).
- Vivek: prep load_test_plan.yaml (we'll start with staging traffic; we can ramp to production-sim later). Confirm runbook for rollbacks in case of instability.
- Me: coordinate invites, update agenda, collect pre-reads into folder, and patch the runbook with contact list.

Deliverables by EOD Mon Feb 22: updated deck (kickoff-deck-v2.pptx), pre-reads in Drive, and load_test_plan.yaml. I created a temp Slack channel: #acme-poc (link in the thread).

I'll draft a short pre-read packet that includes: 1) agenda + objectives, 2) how to prepare (env creds + test dataset sample), 3) roles & timing, 4) quick checklist for attendees. Keep it light.

Thanks — LMK if anything blocks.

Laura

Hi all — confirmed for Tue Mar 1, 10:00–12:30 PT. Calendar invite sent separately.

Attached: kickoff-deck-v2.pptx (slides), load_test_plan.yaml (targets + ramp profile), pre-read-checklist.md (prep questions + creds).

Short agenda highlights (2.5h):
1) 10:00–10:15 — Introductions & success criteria (Aditya)
2) 10:15–11:00 — Prompt review & live tuning (Marissa)
3) 11:00–11:25 — Routing policies demo & decision points (Laura)
4) 11:25–12:00 — Load test run (Vivek + Jenna)
5) 12:00–12:20 — Observations, rollback & next steps (team)
6) 12:20–12:30 — Action items & close

Load test targets (from load_test_plan.yaml):
- Baseline: 50 rps sustained for 10m
- Spike: 500 rps for 3m (ramp 0->500 in 60s)
- Concurrency target: 200 concurrent connections
- SLO: 90p latency < 450ms under baseline

Rollback plan (abridged):
- If error rate > 5% or 90p latency > 1.2s for >60s, abort test and revert routing to canary small model; contact list in runbook.
